title: Leveraging Imperfection with MEDLEY A Multi-Model Approach Harnessing Bias in Medical AI

bias_targets.methodology: Comparing the recognition rates of regionally specific diseases (e.g., Familial Mediterranean Fever) across large language models originating from different geographic regions (e.g., US, Europe, China) using synthetic clinical cases.
Analyzing the frequency of historical versus contemporary disease diagnoses (e.g., HIV/AIDS vs. COVID-19) generated by models in response to synthetic case presentations.

Measuring how often models anchor on or amplify specific demographic traits and social determinants (e.g., homelessness, age, substance use) in their diagnostic reasoning across different synthetic patient profiles.

Evaluating whether models systematically lean toward aggressive versus conservative treatment recommendations when presented with patients from varying socioeconomic or demographic backgrounds (e.g., a homeless patient versus a tech executive).
